name: THE MAP SELLER
note: Doc 07 #16. Sells maps to Mott's strike. Unknowingly employed by the Improvement Company. Genuinely believes in them. The saddest character in the game and he is played entirely for laughs.

barks.R_SWINDLED: Map, sir? Turn it round for you?
barks.R_RACCOON: Map! Dollar! Nothing about raccoons on it, I'll be honest.
barks.R_SURVEYED: You've had a survey! Now you want a map.
barks.R_BORDERS_MOTT: Sir — sir — you've land on it. You're on the map. You're on the map.
barks.R_WON_DUEL: Map for the champion. Ninety cents.
barks.R_DEAD: …Do you want one for the road?

sprite.note: Frames 0-1 are the idle: the pose and a derived one-pixel breath. Frames 2-4 are the three poses from the character sheet. `breaks` are SEPARATE actions chosen from a pool, each leaving the idle and returning to it -- not a routine played in order, which is what the eye catches.
sprite.redrawn: Errata 111 (Tyler, 2026-11-06): drawn from the locked cast master, cast-unify operation 18 (reference/cast-unify-16.txt), full figure, holding his own thing in every pose so it never appears or vanishes; cut with its own pixels and a clean edge on his feet. Its own file: the sheet it replaces is written by an earlier cut.
sprite.figureHeightNote: Crown to sole of the rest frame (tools/art/figure-height.py); the engine draws him at the room's man there.
sprite.frameNote: 0 standing, the map held up beside him · 1 breath (derived) · 2 the map held out, offered · 3 the map lowered · 4 pointing at the map.

migrationNote: ERRATA 54, x6. Was (250, 116) in the 320x144 play area. THE AMBIENT LAYER WAS NEVER MIGRATED: tools/migrate-play-area-x6.mjs is an ALLOWLIST -- "anything not on the list is left exactly as it was" -- and it measured "17 rooms, 140 rects". An ambient character is not a room, so nothing named these and nothing touched them. Every one of them stood in the sky, 13-15% down a 864-tall play area, for as long as errata 54 has been in force, and the game loaded and validated and drew them there.
placeNote: Clear of the small office’s steps. Was (3120, 658).

sprite.note: PHASE 2A: one frame, and that is the phase, not an omission. Static staging first, and Tyler accepts the face in the room before any life is animated on it -- doc 36 Q128. The sheet is pre-scaled to the height this room asks for where the character stands, so the engine draws it at about 1:1 instead of shrinking a 1200 px painting on every frame.

main_street_candidate.note: Unmoved: his placeNote already puts him clear of the small office's steps, on legal ground, with the office lantern over him. Only his SIZE was wrong. An adult man: 1.0.
